segments.text: Ok so this is the Angular quickstart for OpenAI Agents, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, the agent server loops over AGENTS and uses a lifespan, but neither one is ever defined, and no agent is shown.
And the runtime step is just this callout, the linked guide only has a Next.js route.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the agents registry and the runtime server, wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
Moving on to the demo. On my own setup the chat answers, but following only the page, there's nothing you can actually run.
So basically, the backend code is a fragment, no imports, no agent, no registry.
And there's no runtime server for Angular, so you have to build it all yourself.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
